name: Striated Lorikeet
rangeDescription: Mountains of western new guinea (snow mountains to chimbu province)
description: A rare, medium-sized lorikeet of foothill and lower montane forest. Green body with yellow-green striations on the face and underparts, and a gray band from the eye around the back of the head.

name: Long-billed Wren-Babbler
rangeDescription: Eastern himalayas (sikkim to eastern assam and northeastern myanmar)
description: Streaky, short-tailed brown bird with a long, slightly decurved bill; the only wren-babbler in its range to have a long bill. Long pale streaks all over the body give it a slick-feathered appearance.

name: Giant White-eye
rangeDescription: Palau archipelago (babelthuap, urukthapel, and peleliu)
description: A large, dull white-eye with a bright yellowish-orange bill, a yellow eyebrow and eye-ring, and a dark gray cheek. Olive-green below and on the back.

name: Principe Speirops
rangeDescription: Lowlands of príncipe island (gulf of guinea)
description: A bulky, mostly pale white-eye with a whitish head and belly and gray-brown wings and tail. Small to large groups join mixed flocks in forest and plantations throughout Príncipe.

name: White-tufted Honeyeater
rangeDescription: Lesser sundas (wetar to tanimbar and kai islands)
description: A drab olive-brown sparrow-sized songbird with a downcurved bill, dark speckling on the chest, and a small white cheek patch. Juvenile lacks speckling and has pink cheek skin.

name: Mountain Pipit
rangeDescription: South africa (drakensberg mountains of southern lesotho)
description: A large, dark, boldly marked pipit with a pinkish base to the bill. Pairs breed in alpine scrub and grassland above 2000 meters of elevation from October to April, before dispersing to wintering grounds presumed to be in Central Africa.

name: Para Foliage-gleaner
rangeDescription: Brazil south of the amazon river (rio madeira to rio tocantins)
description: Medium-sized and typically noisy foliage-gleaner with an olive-brown back, buff underparts, a white throat, and a rusty tail. Found mainly in humid lowland forest, often near streams, but also sometimes in seasonally flooded forests.

name: Javan Kingfisher
rangeDescription: Lowlands of java and bali
description: Large kingfisher with a massive lipstick-red bill. Note dark head, dark chestnut throat and chest, purplish body, electric blue wings, and large black shoulder patch.

name: Reichard's Seedeater
rangeDescription: Southeastern democratic republic of the congo to zambia, tanzania, malawi, and northern mozambique
description: Medium-sized brown seedeater. Note the boldly marked face with a streaked crown, white eyebrow, and broad dark brown patch through the eye; also note pale streaks on breast.

name: White-necked Parakeet
rangeDescription: Humid lowlands of southeastern ecuador
description: Colorful, long-tailed parakeet restricted to Andean cloud forest in southeastern Ecuador and extreme northern Peru near the border. Combination of white neck, buffy breast, and orange cheek patch separates it from all other parakeets.

name: Black Guan
rangeDescription: Montane forest of costa rica and western panama
description: Large chickenlike bird found in montane forests. Entirely black plumage with blue facial skin, red eye, and reddish legs.

name: Black-and-white Owl
rangeDescription: Lowlands of southern mexico to western ecuador and far northwestern peru
description: Handsome but scarce large owl of tropical lowland forest and edge. Found in forests, plantations, gardens, and towns.

name: Small Pratincole
rangeDescription: Eastern afghanistan and pakistan to india and indochina
description: Small bird that resembles a combination of a dove, a swallow, and a plover. Soft gray-brown with a tan wash on the throat and black lores.

name: Black-bellied Plover
rangeDescription: Holarctic; almost cosmopolitan post-breeding dispersal
description: Chunky, medium-sized shorebird with short, stout bill. In breeding season, shows striking black face and belly with bold black-and-white checkering on upperparts; note clean white undertail.

name: Swinhoe's Snipe
rangeDescription: Siberia; winters india to southeastern asia, philippines, and northern australia
description: Large, marsh-dwelling shorebird of wetlands, wet meadows, and both flooded and dry agricultural fields. Extremely difficult to distinguish from other species of snipe, especially Pin-tailed Snipe, and careful study and photography usually required to confirm identification.

name: Blue-headed Macaw
rangeDescription: Eastern peru to northern bolivia and far western brazil
description: Small macaw of lowland rainforest. Its dull blue head is distinctive; the species is otherwise green with blue wings.

name: Eurasian Dotterel
rangeDescription: Western alaska and northern palearctic; winters north africa to western iran
description: Handsome plover with a gentle, dove-like face. Breeding plumage distinctive, with bold white eyebrow, white breast band above rusty-orange belly with black center.

name: Philippine Pied-Fantail
rangeDescription: Philippines and sulu archipelago
description: A medium-sized, long-tailed bird of wooded and fairly open areas in the lowlands. Sooty-gray above and white below, with a black chest band and black face.

name: Stripe-faced Wood-Quail
rangeDescription: Andes of southeastern peru and northern bolivia
description: Chunky, dark brown quail of cloud forest and elfin forest. Dark brown body is spotted white below; black bandit mask and reddish crown are distinctive.

name: Muscovy Duck
rangeDescription: Lowlands from northern mexico south, west of the andes, to southwestern ecuador and, east of the andes, to northeastern argentina and brazil
description: Large, hefty duck that has wild and domestic types. Wild birds are dark blackish overall with iridescent green and bronze, especially on the wings.
